basics.name: Yanzhe Zhao
basics.label: Computational & Cognitive Neuroscience | Neurolinguistics
basics.summary: Final-year Automation undergraduate at Tianjin University. Visiting student in Shanshan Qin Lab, Shanghai Jiao Tong University. My research interests lie in computational and cognitive neuroscience and neurolinguistics. I am interested in how neural population dynamics implement cognition across levels of biological organization, how neurally based cognitive capacities emerge through evolution, the neural mechanisms of language processing and acquisition, and the neural basis of conscious subjective experience.

courses: Machine Learning based on Optimization Theory: 92

work.name: Shanshan Qin Lab, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
work.summary: Longitudinal neural representations and computational modeling.
highlights: Analyze longitudinal neural recordings to investigate the relationship between representational drift and representational sparsity.
Develop computational models to investigate candidate mechanisms underlying representational drift.
Initiating an undergraduate thesis project on computational modeling of circadian clock networks.
